import json, base64, gzip, os
with open('/Users/arijit/Downloads/DataQ Landing Page.html', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()
manifest = json.loads(lines[371])
outdir = '/tmp/dataq_landing_assets'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
ext_map = {'image/svg+xml':'svg','text/javascript':'js','application/javascript':'js','font/ttf':'ttf'}
for uuid, v in manifest.items():
    raw = base64.b64decode(v['data'])
    if v.get('compressed'):
        raw = gzip.decompress(raw)
    ext = ext_map.get(v['mime'], 'bin')
    path = os.path.join(outdir, f'{uuid}.{ext}')
    with open(path, 'wb') as out:
        out.write(raw)
    print(uuid, v['mime'], len(raw), path)
"

        vf = f"tpad=stop_mode=clone:stop_duration={pad_needed}" if pad_needed > 0 else "null"

import json, subprocess, os

DIR = "$DIR"
WEBM = "$WEBM"
INTRO_WEBM = "$INTRO_WEBM"
audio_dir = os.path.join(DIR, "audio")
final_dir = os.path.join(DIR, "final_clips2")
os.makedirs(final_dir, exist_ok=True)
BUFFER = 0.4

def dur_of(path):
    out = subprocess.run(["ffprobe","-v","error","-show_entries","format=duration",
                           "-of","default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", path],
                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return float(out)

list_path = os.path.join(final_dir, "list.txt")
entries = []  # (index_label, source_webm, start, video_dur, narr_path)

# Intro: whole clip, no start offset.
intro_video_dur = dur_of(INTRO_WEBM)
entries.append(("00_intro", INTRO_WEBM, 0.0, intro_video_dur, os.path.join(audio_dir, "intro.aiff")))

marks = json.load(open(os.path.join(DIR, "marks.json")))
for i, m in enumerate(marks):
    label = m["label"]
    start = m["t"] / 1000.0
    video_dur = m["dur"] / 1000.0
    narr_path = os.path.join(audio_dir, f"{i:02d}_{label}.aiff")
    entries.append((f"{i+1:02d}_{label}", WEBM, start, video_dur, narr_path))

with open(list_path, "w") as lf:
    for name, src, start, video_dur, narr_path in entries:
        narr_dur = dur_of(narr_path)
        target = max(video_dur, narr_dur + 0.3) + BUFFER

        raw_clip = os.path.join(final_dir, f"{name}_raw.mp4")
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-y","-ss",str(start),"-i",src,"-t",str(video_dur),
                         "-c:v","libx264","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-an", raw_clip],
                        check=True, capture_output=True)

        pad_needed = max(0.0, target - video_dur)
        padded_clip = os.path.join(final_dir, f"{name}_padded.mp4")
        vf = f"tpad=stop_mode=clone:stop_duration={pad_needed}" if pad_needed > 0 else "null"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-y","-i",raw_clip,"-vf",vf,"-c:v","libx264","-pix_fmt","yuv420p",
                         padded_clip], check=True, capture_output=True)

        narr_aac = os.path.join(final_dir, f"{name}_narr.m4a")
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-y","-i",narr_path,"-af","apad","-t",str(target),
                         "-c:a","aac","-b:a","128k", narr_aac], check=True, capture_output=True)

        combined = os.path.join(final_dir, f"{name}.mp4")
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-y","-i",padded_clip,"-i",narr_aac,
                         "-c:v","copy","-c:a","aac","-shortest", combined],
                        check=True, capture_output=True)

        lf.write(f"file '{os.path.abspath(combined)}'\n")
        print(name, "video_dur", round(video_dur,2), "narr_dur", round(narr_dur,2), "target", round(target,2))

print("DONE", list_path)

DIR="/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-arijit-Coding-Python-DataQ/18fad75b-075f-48e0-9fdf-dbf0ddef0b27/scratchpad/demo-video2"

python3 <<EOF
import json, subprocess, os

DIR = "$DIR"
WEBM = "$WEBM"
INTRO_WEBM = "$INTRO_WEBM"
audio_dir = os.path.join(DIR, "audio")
final_dir = os.path.join(DIR, "final_clips")
os.makedirs(final_dir, exist_ok=True)

def dur_of(path):
    out = subprocess.run(["ffprobe","-v","error","-show_entries","format=duration",
                           "-of","default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", path],
                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    return float(out)

marks = json.load(open(os.path.join(DIR, "marks.json")))
entries = [("00_intro", INTRO_WEBM, 0.0, dur_of(INTRO_WEBM), os.path.join(audio_dir, "intro.aiff"))]
for i, m in enumerate(marks):
    label = m["label"]
    start = m["t"] / 1000.0
    video_dur = m["dur"] / 1000.0
    narr_path = os.path.join(audio_dir, f"{i:02d}_{label}.aiff")
    entries.append((f"{i+1:02d}_{label}", WEBM, start, video_dur, narr_path))

names = []
for name, src, start, video_dur, narr_path in entries:
    # Video: exact-duration extract, forced constant 25fps, no padding filter.
    vclip = os.path.join(final_dir, f"{name}_v.mp4")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-y","-ss",str(start),"-i",src,"-t",str(video_dur),
                     "-r","25","-vsync","cfr","-c:v","libx264","-pix_fmt","yuv420p","-an", vclip],
                    check=True, capture_output=True)
    # Audio: narration padded with trailing silence to the exact video duration.
    aclip = os.path.join(final_dir, f"{name}_a.m4a")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg","-y","-i",narr_path,"-af","apad","-t",str(video_dur),
                     "-ar","44100","-c:a","aac","-b:a","128k", aclip],
                    check=True, capture_output=True)
    names.append(name)
    print(name, "video_dur", round(video_dur,2))

print("DONE", len(names), "segments")
with open(os.path.join(final_dir, "names.json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump(names, f)
EOF

gh issue create --title "marketing/index.html ships as an unbuilt Claude-Artifact bundle (no-JS/SEO/crawler risk)" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Context

\`marketing/index.html\` (added in #1560) is a raw Claude Design "bundler" export — a small bootstrap shell that unpacks a compressed manifest and in-browser Babel-transpiles several JSX chunks, minting React/ReactDOM/Babel + font blobs at runtime. It was deliberately kept as-is (self-contained, zero build step) so it could be reviewed/edited quickly and published without adding a frontend build pipeline for a single static page.

## The tradeoff

- **No-JS / crawler risk:** a visitor with JS disabled, or a search-engine/social-card crawler that doesn't execute JS, sees only the "This page requires JavaScript to display" fallback — no actual marketing content, hurting SEO and social-preview generation.
- **Runtime cost:** every visit pays for decompressing the manifest + in-browser Babel transpilation instead of shipping pre-built HTML/JS.
- **Failure mode:** if the manifest fails to decompress or the Babel/React blobs fail to load, the visitor is stuck on the "Unpacking…" status with no fallback content.

## Proposed fix (not done here)

Pre-render the page to static HTML (or migrate it into a minimal build step — e.g. a tiny Vite/esbuild pass) so it degrades gracefully without JS and crawlers see real content. Low priority — the page works correctly for the overwhelmingly common case (a real browser with JS enabled) and there's no build pipeline in this repo for marketing assets today.

Filed per CLAUDE.md's "every finding ends fixed or filed" rule — flagged by \`/code-review\` on #1560, deliberately not fixed there (scope was "finalize wording/links", not "add a build pipeline").
EOF
)"

import json

path = "/Users/arijit/Coding/Python/DataQ/marketing/index.html"
with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

new_tmpl_html = open("/tmp/tmpl_edit.html", encoding="utf-8").read()
dumped = json.dumps(new_tmpl_html)
# Match the original bundler's escaping: forward slashes as / so an
# embedded </script>, </style> etc. can never prematurely close the real
# <script type="__bundler/template"> tag the HTML tokenizer sees.
dumped = dumped.replace("/", "\\u002F")
lines[383] = dumped + "\n"

with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.writelines(lines)

print("rewrote line 384, new length", len(dumped))
EOF
